import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fstatistic

# Get top marker genes for each cluster using Wilcoxon test
markers = []
for cluster in ['3', '12', '18', '0']:
    cluster_cells = adata.obs[adata.obs['leiden'] == cluster].index
    other_cells = adata.obs[adata.obs['leiden'] != cluster].index
    
    # Calculate log-fold change and test statistic
    cluster_data = adata[cluster_cells].X.toarray() if sparse.issparse(adata[cluster_cells].X) else adata[cluster_cells].X
    other_data = adata[other_cells].X.toarray() if sparse.issparse(adata[other_cells].X) else adata[other_cells].X
    
    # Mean expression
    cluster_mean = np.mean(cluster_data, axis=0)
    other_mean = np.mean(other_data, axis=0)
    
    # Log fold change
    # Add small pseudocount to avoid log(0)
    cluster_mean_safe = cluster_mean + 0.001
    other_mean_safe = other_mean + 0.001
    logfc = np.log2(cluster_mean_safe / other_mean_safe)
    
    # Simple Wilcoxon-like rank sum test (f-statistic approximation)
    f_stat, _ = fstatistic(cluster_data.T, other_data.T)
    
    gene_names = adata.var_names
    
    cluster_markers = pd.DataFrame({
        'gene': gene_names,
        'logfc': logfc,
        'f_stat': f_stat,
        'cluster_mean': cluster_mean,
        'other_mean': other_mean
    })
    cluster_markers = cluster_markers.sort_values('f_stat', ascending=False).head(10)
    cluster_markers['cluster'] = cluster
    markers.append(cluster_markers)

all_markers = pd.concat(markers)
print("Top 10 marker genes per cluster:")
for cluster in ['3', '12', '18', '0']:
    print(f"\n=== Cluster {cluster} ===")
    print(all_markers[all_markers['cluster'] == cluster][['gene', 'logfc', 'f_stat']].to_string(index=False))
